paragraphs.text: Aztec Batman: Clash of Empires () is a 2025 adult animated historical superhero film based on the DC Comics character Batman. It is a collaboration between Ánima, Chatrone and Warner Bros. Animation, with Juan Meza-León as director and writer. The film was released in Mexican theaters by Cinépolis Distribución on September 18, 2025 and in North America by Warner Bros. Home Entertainment on September 19, 2025.
Aztec Batman: Clash of Empires has grossed $648,067 in Mexico, and $15,177 in Colombia, for a worldwide total of $663,244.
